number_format: Printed with '.' as thousands separator (e.g. '53.400 dN' = 53 400 dN). 1 dN = 10 N.
text_statements: p. 220: results of the RISER program are compared with results from eight other programs for six riser examples (reference 2: API Bulletin 2J, 1977).
p. 220: all examples use a 40.64 cm (16 in) riser with a ball joint at the base and an expansion joint at the head.
p. 220: 'Only the riser of 914.40 m has buoyant material attached.'

p. 220: the tension at the head is assumed constant during the dynamic calculation; choke and kill lines are 'broadside' to waves and current and do not contribute to riser stiffness; the problem is two dimensional.
